title: The Business of Healing: How to Build Profitable, Mission-Driven Healthcare Businesses
description: Build Healthcare Businesses That Work Clinical brilliance doesn't guarantee business success. Every year, talented healthcare professionals launch practices and watch them struggle because medical training never covered cash flow, compliance, or scaling operations. The Business of Healing fills that gap. Stephen and Sterling Carter, fraternal twins who've built and scaled therapy, hospice, and staffing companies, deliver the practical business education healthcare professionals need. Inside, you'll discover: how to shift from clinician to CEO and build teams that scale without your constant involvement create systems and processes that maintain quality as you grow navigate healthcare compliance and become bankable to lenders and investors leverage technology and automation to reduce burnout and improve patient care Grounded in real-world experience and packed with actionable frameworks, The Business of Healing shows clinicians, executives, and aspiring entrepreneurs how to build profitable, people-first healthcare ventures. title: Mission Requires Margin: A Physician's Guide to Building Healthcare Organizations That Wor
description: Healthcare organizations do not fail because people do not care. They fail because clinical excellence, finance, research, education, operations, philanthropy, technology, and patient experience are treated as separate problems. Mission Requires Margin is a physician’s guide to building healthcare organizations that work. Drawing on a career across charitable care, private practice, academic medicine, international programs, nonprofit leadership, and large health systems, Dr. Pablo Castañeda examines the hidden architecture of healthcare strategy: how volume becomes learning, how research becomes authority, how philanthropy creates possibility, how teams become durable, and how good clinical work reaches patients at scale. This is not a management textbook and not a memoir. It is a practical argument for physician leaders, hospital executives, department chairs, administrators, entrepreneurs, and anyone responsible for improving healthcare delivery. Inside, readers will learn how to: • Build clinical programs around the five essential functions of patient care, research, education, administration, and philanthropy • Turn clinical volume into better outcomes, research, training, reputation, and sustainable growth • Understand the financial and institutional incentives that shape real healthcare decisions • Recruit, retain, and develop teams without relying on heroics • Design patient communication, shared decision-making, and reliable follow-up as clinical infrastructure • Create a clinical front door that routes patients to the right care, with the right information, at the right time • Use artificial intelligence to improve access, documentation, and decision support without surrendering clinical judgment • Build organizations that are less dependent on exceptional ind

description: The AI-Powered Healthcare Entrepreneur How to Launch, Automate, and Scale the Future of Care The healthcare industry is changing faster than ever before. title: Clinician to CEO: A Blueprint for Building and Scaling a Thriving Healthcare Practice
description: You became a clinician to help people improve their health and quality of life. Building your own practice gives you the opportunity to provide care while creating a career that aligns with your goals and values. Clinician to CEO provides practical guidance for nurse practitioners, DNPs, and healthcare professionals who want to start and grow their own practice. Inside, you will learn: • How to transition from employee to practice owner • Steps to legally establish and launch your practice • How to navigate credentialing, insurance, and day-to-day operations • Strategies for attracting and retaining patients • Approaches to growing your practice while maintaining work-life balance Written by Dr. Olubunmi Awe, DNP, founder of Peace Health and Wellness Clinic and AimHigh Institute, this book is based on years of clinical and business experience. The companion workbook helps you apply each concept with practical exercises and action steps. title: The Business of Building and Managing a Healthcare Practice: Going Beyond the Basics (Medi
description: Building on the foundation of the previous edition, this book takes readers to the next level of management of medical practices for the 21st century. The road to becoming a physician is not an easy one to travel, nor does it become easier once a doctor completes his\her training. After a long and arduous training process, doctors embark on their professional journey, and there are major crossroads that are fraught with challenges, unknowns and risk. The transition to professional practice is daunting, and many physicians leave their training unprepared for the business of medicine. Even at the peak of their careers, sustaining a successful and profitable practice is not easy. Opening chapters revisit the basic business concepts that every physician needs to know, emphasizing the benefits that accrue to a physician who understands the basics of business, from accounting and contracts to managing people and personal finances. The next set of chaptersoffers a roadmap for doctors who are beginning a medical practice and will include new methods and procedures that have become available since the original edition, defining the various options for doctors’ employment such as solo practice, group practice and academic medicine. The final chapters emphasize strategies on how to build and grow a successful practice, including the use of technology and telemedicine, cybersecurity, marketing and much more. Unfortunately, not every doctor has the background, training and skills to manage a medical practice. title: The Leaky Practice: An Operational Blueprint for Building a More Profitable, Efficient, an
description: Stop fixing symptoms. Start fixing the system. From the outside, successful healthcare practices all look the same. Busy schedules. Full waiting rooms. Phones ringing. Providers working harder than ever. Yet beneath the surface, thousands of dollars quietly disappear every week through missed phone calls, scheduling gaps, poor communication, inconsistent systems, low treatment acceptance, employee disengagement, and operational inefficiencies. These are the leaks. In The Leaky Practice , Dr. Faheem Inayatali introduces a practical framework for identifying and eliminating the hidden operational problems that quietly limit growth in healthcare organizations. Drawing from more than two decades of experience building healthcare practices, developing operational technology, and helping organizations improve performance, this book shows why sustainable growth rarely comes from working harder or spending more on marketing. It comes from building better systems. Inside you'll learn how to: • Identify where revenue is leaking throughout the patient journey • Build systems that improve consistency and accountability • Increase treatment acceptance and patient retention • Reduce scheduling inefficiencies and no-shows • Create high-performing teams and stronger workplace culture • Improve the patient experience from first contact through long-term loyalty • Build a practice that grows because of its systems—not because of the owner's constant presence Whether you're a physician, dentist, optometrist, practice owner, administrator, or healthcare leader, The Leaky Practice provides practical frameworks, real-world examples, and actionable strategies that can immediately improve operational performance. The best practices don't necessarily work harder. They simply leak less.  if(wind

description: The healthcare staffing industry is exploding. With the global market projected to reach $47.8 billion in 2026 , there has never been a better time to position yourself in this lucrative B2B sector. Whether you are in Canada, the US, or the UK, the demand for qualified healthcare workers is at an all-time high. In this comprehensive guide, Bolarinwa Famose , founder of Rogami Care Services, pulls back the curtain on the exact strategies he used to build and run a successful healthcare staffing agency. This isn't just a book of abstract theories; it is a practical, tactical blueprint designed to take you from scratch to a high-profit venture. The Care Contract: Master the art of securing contracts with hospitals, nursing homes, and pharmaceutical companies. Staffing Mastery: Proven techniques for sourcing, managing, and prioritizing the welfare of your staff to ensure long-term retention. Profit Maximization: Learn how to streamline your procedures to match the best candidates with the right roles, ensuring client satisfaction and repeat business. The Power of Referrals: How to leverage your network to grow your agency exponentially. Who is this for? Aspiring Entrepreneurs: Anyone looking to enter a recession-proof industry with a clear, simple-to-follow roadmap.
